title: Zero, unset, and not-measured semantics
acceptanceCriteria: Measured zero remains valid; unset and not-measured remain unknown and are never silently coerced to zero.
summary: Requirement B01-03 is fully satisfied in both specification (057 spec.md US3, FR-009, FR-010, C02) and codebase implementation. Explicit numeric zero (0/0.00) is preserved through coerce_optional_decimal and accepted by serializers. Unset (null) and not-measured (quantity_measured=False) are handled as unknown, rendered as localized neutral badges with caution outlines (ثبت‌نشده / Unset), and never coerced to zero in daily aggregation or export views. Domain-invalid zeros (materials receipts, pressure/concrete) remain strictly guarded by positive-only checks.
